utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many repair sign-ups do we have so far, and what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’ve got a decent start on sign-ups, but I need to check the latest count before I say for sure. Still need a few people for equipment pickup and the volunteer schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you check the count now, and tell me which equipment pickup slots are still open?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a few tools for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that’d be helpful, thanks. I might have missed a few details, but I can come by and pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, come by anytime today and I’ll set them aside for you. I’ve got a hammer, tape measure, and a couple screwdrivers ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is picking up a few more drop-offs this afternoon, so it should be pretty busy. Pia, are you still planning to swing by?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Maybe, but I need to check the timing first so I don’t get stuck waiting around.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That makes sense. If you want, I can let you know when the line starts thinning out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you check the West End depot and the old town hall basement? I’m keeping track of which locations still need a pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can check both and report back which pickups are still there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling folks about the repair drive now, and I’ll swing by with the details so you can pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll pass it along when you bring the details by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll drop by soon with the details so you can share them around.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m lining up the repair drive now, Leo. If you’ve got a few names or a time that works, send them my way and I’ll add it in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can send a few names later today. Early evening works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, early evening it is. Send the names when you can, and I’ll slot them in with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I should check the details first before I say more. What exactly needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the porch rail, a couple loose steps, and the hall light that keeps flickering.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. I’ll note the porch rail, the loose steps, and the flickering hall light before I say anything else.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule, but I need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye. I’ll send the repair drive details and the school schedule options so we can line everything up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, send both when you have them and I’ll line up the times.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive's coming together, but I’m probably missing some details. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming along well so far, mostly a mix of tool drop-offs, a few volunteers, and a list of folks who need help with small fixes. I’m still pulling the final details together, but I can tell you what’s confirmed so far.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps a lot. If you’ve got the confirmed list, I’d be glad to hear it so I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll keep it brief. What’s the repair drive need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirm you’re bringing the tools and that you can help for an hour, okay?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m bringing the tools and can help for an hour.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, thanks, Rey. I could use help sorting the donations and keeping a list of what folks bring by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll sort what comes in and keep the list updated as people drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll pass the repair drive plan along to everyone I see.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know if anything runs low.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll do that, and I’ll keep telling folks about the repair drive whenever I run into them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up again this week. I can swing by after errands and drop off what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I’ll be around after noon if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: After noon works for me. I’ll stop by once I’m done and bring the parts I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I was meaning to bring that up, just give me a sec to remember the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, take your time. I can go over the repair drive plan again when you're ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik. I’m coming back to it now, I just need the quick version again so I don’t mix anything up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I missed the details, but I can check in and see what's needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Noah. Just let me know what they still need and I’ll handle my part.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll ask around and see what’s still missing, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with that. Tell me what you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll bring the list by tomorrow morning and we can go through it step by step.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli. I’ll keep my tools ready and we can sort it out tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Mara. We still need a few volunteers for pickups, someone to sort donated tools, and a couple of folks to hand out flyers by the corner store.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll take flyers by the corner store and keep track of the volunteer list. Let me know who’s still needed for pickups and tool sorting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help line people up for the repair drive and keep everyone posted on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll keep track of where each person is needed and which spots are already covered.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I’ll share the open spots with the right folks and nudge anyone who can fill a gap.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’m lining up the first few homes to check this afternoon. If you can help me flag anyone who’s been waiting longest, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can do that. I’ll check my notes and point you to the folks who’ve been waiting the longest.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo. Send me the names when you have them, and I’ll make sure we start with those homes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is getting organized, but I’m still catching up on the details. What do you know so far, Mina?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not much yet, just that it’s being pulled together and people are gathering what needs fixing. What part are you trying to figure out?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m trying to figure out what needs the most help first, and whether there’s a place for me to pitch in once I know more.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I’ll skim the details and do what I can for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo. I’ll send the schedule details and the list of what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, send it over and I’ll take a look when I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive, Kira. Tell me what you need me to bring or do.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what exactly you want me to bring, and when you need it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Please bring any basic tools you have, plus gloves and trash bags if you can. I need them by Saturday morning.
